# Support

[Français](../SUPPORT.md) · **English**

- **Getting started.** Read the [getting started guide](../../docs/en/getting-started.md) or [ask the community](https://github.com/LINDECKER-Charles/Bloodborne-Legendary-Run-public/discussions/categories/q-a).
- **App bugs.** Use the [GitHub form](https://github.com/LINDECKER-Charles/Bloodborne-Legendary-Run-public/issues/new?template=04-bug-en.yml) or the [form on the official site](https://bloodborne-legendary-run.com/en/report-bug) if you don’t have repository access.
- **Account and personal data.** Use the [data rights request form](https://bloodborne-legendary-run.com/en/data-request) or the contact listed in the [legal notice](https://bloodborne-legendary-run.com/en/legal).
- **Abusive behavior.** See the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- **Vulnerabilities.** Use the private channel described in the [security policy](SECURITY.md).
